reason: The 45 meetings for a logistics company catches my eye, and I do need something for next year's new country, but I already paid an agency once and got nothing. EUR 3,500 up front plus 1,800 a month with no meeting number guaranteed is the same promise I've heard before.
objection: No guaranteed meetings and no cost per meeting I can check. I pay 3,500 first and only find out in 30-60 days whether it works, and by then I'm already on 1,800 a month.
would_change_my_mind: A call with that logistics client so I can check the 45 meetings myself, plus a refund or free months if the sprint brings fewer than an agreed number of qualified meetings.
